app.name: Bima Audit
app.tagline: Every TPA asks 'what can we deduct?' We ask 'is this deduction legally allowed?'

settings.title: Settings
settings.plainHint: Explains every deduction in everyday words.
settings.demo: Demo data · not connected to Supabase

reason.list_match: Matched to the IRDAI list by item name.
reason.exempt_from_prorata: Pharmacy, implants, devices, diagnostics and ICU cannot be cut in proportion to room rent.
reason.prorata_scaled: Scaled because the room rent exceeds the policy cap.
reason.prorata_waived_non_differential: Hospital charges the same rates for every room category, so no proportionate cut applies.
reason.prorata_waived_package: Billed at a fixed package rate, so no proportionate cut applies.
reason.room_over_cap: Room rent above the policy cap; the excess is not payable.
reason.remapped_into_bucket: Absorbed into its proper charge head.

case.swipeHint: Swipe amber rows right to absorb them into the correct head.

rebuttal.modeDualSub: Formal English for the TPA, Hindi summary for the policyholder
rebuttal.title: Representation against deductions in final bill
rebuttal.to: To: The Claims Officer, {tpa} on behalf of {insurer}
rebuttal.intro: We request reconsideration of the following deductions, each of which is contrary to the IRDAI provisions cited.
rebuttal.none: No disputable deductions on this case.
rebuttal.generated: Generated {date}. Amounts computed deterministically from the itemised bill and policy schedule.

consent.title: Before You Upload
consent.p1: We read the bill and policy only to check deductions against IRDAI rules.
consent.p2: Names, phone, Aadhaar, PAN and policy numbers are hidden on your device before anything is sent.
consent.p3: Original files are deleted automatically after 72 hours.
consent.p4: You can delete the case and all files at any time.

upload.redactHint: The header is blurred automatically. Paint over anything else that shows a name, phone or address.
upload.rejected: This file can't be used ({reason}). Upload a PDF, JPEG or PNG under 15 MB.
upload.rateLimited: Too many scans. Try again in {minutes} min.
upload.notConfigured: Bill reading isn't set up on this server yet (no Anthropic API key).
upload.reviewHint: Read from the uploaded bill. Untick anything that was misread, then add the rest to the case.
upload.added: {count} lines added and checked against IRDAI rules.
upload.warnInstructions: This bill contained text trying to give instructions to the reader. It was ignored and the lines were transcribed as printed — check each one.
upload.warnTotal: Lines add up to {sum}, but the bill's printed total is {total}. Some lines may be missing or misread.
upload.warnLowConfidence: Lines marked in amber were hard to read.
upload.deskReview: Uploaded. The hospital desk will review the bill.
upload.err_scanned_pdf: This PDF is a scan with no text. Take a photo of the bill instead, so personal details can be blurred first.
upload.err_refused: The bill couldn't be read automatically. Enter the lines by hand.
upload.err_too_long: The bill is too long to read in one go. Upload it in parts.
upload.err_invalid_output: The bill was read but the result failed validation. Try again or upload a clearer copy.
upload.err_no_lines: No billed lines were found in this document.
upload.err_ocr_busy: Bill reading is busy. Try again in a minute.

family.heroSub: Show this to the billing counter. These cuts are not allowed under IRDAI rules.
family.speech: On this bill, {amount} has been deducted that IRDAI rules do not allow. {points}
family.whatsapp: Bima Audit — Case {caseId}: {amount} of the TPA's deductions are not permitted under IRDAI rules. Rebuttal attached.

auth.title: Sign In
auth.failed: Sign-in failed. Check your email and password.
auth.familyHint: Family members: use the email link — no password needed.

claim.title: Open Your Case
claim.claiming: Linking this case to your account…
claim.failed: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask the hospital desk for a new one.
claim.shareText: Follow the insurance audit for case {caseId}: {url}

status.payable: Insurance must pay this in full.
status.payable_addon: Your add-on covers this, so insurance must pay it.
status.prorata_exempt: Medicines, tests, implants and ICU cannot be cut because of your room.
status.subsumed: This can't be charged separately; it belongs inside your room or operation charge.
status.remapped: Moved into the right charge, so it is now covered.
status.non_payable: IRDAI rules don't cover this non-medical item (unless you have a consumables add-on).
status.prorata_trap: You took a room costlier than your policy limit, so doctor and OT fees are being cut in the same ratio.
status.room_excess: Your room costs more per day than your policy allows; you pay the difference.

rule.prorata_exempt: Cutting medicines, tests, implants or ICU because of the room is not allowed.

sla.delay_alert: If discharge approval takes more than 3 hours, the insurer must bear the hospital's extra charges.
